description: Removes one timeline message from a report by `update_id`. The report itself and the other messages stay. The initial update (created with the report) cannot be deleted — attempt returns 400; delete the whole report instead.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

name: status_page_incident_report_update_delete
title: Delete a timeline update from incident report
